# faraday_market_opportunity_analysis (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "faraday_cohort" "customers" {
  name        = "customers"
  stream_name = "orders"
}

resource "faraday_outcome" "repeat_purchase" {
  name                 = "repeat_purchase"
  attainment_cohort_id = faraday_cohort.customers.id
}

resource "faraday_scope" "export" {
  name    = "export"
  preview = true
  population = {
    cohort_ids = [faraday_cohort.customers.id]
  }
  payload = {}
}

resource "faraday_market_opportunity_analysis" "market" {
  name       = "market"
  scope_id   = faraday_scope.export.id
  outcome_id = faraday_outcome.repeat_purchase.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable label for this market opportunity analysis
- `outcome_id` (String) Outcome must be in the scope payload.
- `scope_id` (String)

### Optional

- `aggregate` (String) The entity this analysis counts. `person` (the default) counts individuals. `residence` counts households: people at the same address collapse into one entity before any metric is computed. How a household's member scores combine is not selectable. A residence analysis uses the best-scoring member — the household counts as the prospect its strongest member makes it, matching the rule that a household has attained if any member has.
- `locations` (Attributes) The atlas locations this analysis covers. If absent, the analysis is not based on locations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `persona_id` (String) persona_id must belong to the persona_set_id chosen. Providing a persona_id will do further analysis on the persona, but is not required to generate results for the persona set as a whole.
- `persona_set_id` (String) Optionally select a persona set to analyze. Persona set must be in the scope payload.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) If not null, this resource will no longer receive updates, but will still be visable.
- `created_at` (String) When this resource was created.
- `google_sheets_url` (String) URL to the Google Sheets spreadsheet of the market opportunity analysis. Available once the market opportunity analysis has been run. Permission to view the spreadsheet is granted to all users on the current account.
- `google_slides_url` (String) URL to the Google Slides presentation of the market opportunity analysis. Available once the market opportunity analysis has been run. Permission to view the presentation is granted to all users on the current account.
- `id` (String) A unique ID for this resource.
- `last_read_input_at` (String) The last time this resource's input was read.
- `last_updated_config_at` (String) The last time this resource's configuration was updated. If this is more recent than last_updated_output_at, the resource will be rebuilt.
- `last_updated_output_at` (String) The last time this resource successfully built.
- `overall_report` (Attributes) Summary over the latest report. Available once the market opportunity analysis has been run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--overall_report))
- `resource_type` (String) The type of this resource.
- `status` (String) The current state of this resource and any updates.
- `status_changed_at` (String) When the status of this resource was last updated.
- `status_error` (String) If this resource has `status == "error"`, this will contain an error message.
- `updated_at` (String) When this resource was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Optional:

- `atlas_ids` (List of String) The atlases whose locations this analysis covers. If this is empty or absent, every atlas in the account is used.
- `location_reference_keys` (List of String) Cover only the locations carrying these reference keys. A reference key is unique only within one atlas, so these keys are matched in every atlas this analysis covers. Select a single atlas to restrict them to that atlas' keys.
- `property_conditions` (Attributes List) Cover only the locations whose properties satisfy these conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations--property_conditions))

<a id="nestedatt--locations--property_conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations.property_conditions`

Required:

- `property` (String) The name of the location property, as defined by its atlas' `output_to_locations`, or `name` or `reference_key` to filter on the location's own name or reference key.

Optional:

- `_eq` (String) Equal to
- `_gt` (Number) Greater than
- `_gte` (Number) Greater than or equal to
- `_in` (List of String) Value is one of
- `_lt` (Number) Less than
- `_lte` (Number) Less than or equal to
- `_matches` (String) Value contains a match to the regex (re2) expression provided. For an exact regex match, use the ^ and $ characters as specified by the (re2 documentation)[https://github.com/google/re2/wiki/Syntax].
- `_neq` (String) Not equal to
- `_nin` (List of String) Value is not one of
- `_nnull` (Boolean) Value is not null
- `_null` (Boolean) Value is null (nulls are otherwise excluded)
- `optional` (Boolean) Optional property conditions are unioned together, when combined they select locations that meet either property condition. At least one optional condition must be satisfied.
